positioning: tooling/metadata surface only; not a criteria change; no user signature required

captured_at.rule: explicit non-empty ISO8601 only; missing/empty/non-ISO8601 => non-zero exit before any GPU work; never write an empty string
captured_at.dry_run: does not consume the env; echoes {present, non_empty} only

per_world_scope.covers: per-world light poses + per-world geom poses (nworld>1), with the host-only light semantics premise of spec v2 §10.3
per_world_scope.does_not_cover: AA x perworld, single-launch performance plan K, continuous animation/large world counts, upstream-implementation equivalence claims
per_world_scope.negative: old wording 'per-world light poses (device path indexes lights single-world)' rejected when present

task_id_decision.reference_tag_default: reference directory name (spec v2 §2.2 tag convention)
task_id_decision.why: task_id identifies the authoring-script provenance; parametrising it would reopen the provenance ambiguity §11.1 item 4 asks to close; a separate reference_tag aligns with the spec tag concept and keeps both facts traceable without changing task_id semantics.

scripts/capture_render_perworld.py.note: import metadata module; --reference-tag; early strict env validation on capture path (before GPU); dry-run echo update; capture.json merges metadata block; post-write self-check

scripts/perworld_capture_meta.py.note: command capture, strict captured_at env, per_world_scope wording, reference_tag resolution, capture.json metadata block, write self-check, 14-case CPU self-check

self_checks.synthetic_shape: artifacts/synthetic-capture-metadata.json (SYNTHETIC; not a reference, no GPU)

non_claims.statement: Tooling/metadata only; produces no reference, makes no capture-validity claim, no per-world light acceptance claim, no upstream-implementation equivalence claim and no rendering numeric conclusion; G-L1/G-L2 still follow the spec v2 signature/GO flow.
